description: Page speed and page weight audit of a web page from one real browser load: total bytes transferred, HTTP request count and DOM node count, measured rather than estimated, with findings when the page is heavy. Page-weight signals, not Core Web Vitals. $0.05 per call. Returns: pass (bool), metrics{}, findings[] with id/severity/detail.

url.description: Live, fetchable http(s) URL to audit.

name: audit_performance

findings.description: One entry per rule that did not pass. Empty when the check is clean.

pass.description: Whether every rule in this dimension passed.

status.description: Present only on a completed audit.

title: Page performance audit
